positions.name: CalibrationVerificationClaim
positions.frame: how is spectrograph calibration verification established as settled fact?
positions.why: Both expressions assert calibration verification against June reference plates as unhedged claims at the same conviction level — src-1 through Quill's expert assertion with communal 'we verified' and calm-positive register, src-3 through flat record cataloguing. They share present-realis temporality, competence value appeal, and informational power, showing the verification moving from performed assertion to recorded fact while both appeal to mastery through reference standards. The tension between src-1's technical-register expert voice and src-3's matter-of-fact cataloguing voice is held by the frame: both are the same verification claim performed at different documentary registers.
